newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison mulls San Francisco projects.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison mulls San Francisco projects.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd was exploring investment opportunities in San Francisco, a Hutchison group official said on Friday.
"We are in initial stages of exploring opportunities there but details (of the projcets) are not available yet," a spokeswoman for Hutchison group told Reuters on Friday.

Hutchison was interested in two property development projects on San Francisco's shoreline, and unit Hutchison Port Holdings was also studying possible participation in the development of San Francisco port, lcoal newspapers quoted San Francisco Mayor Willie Brown as saying during a visit to China.
"There are preliminary talks over the San Francisco port project and we are interested (in the project)," said a Hutchison Port Holdings spokeswoman.

Brown is leading a business delegation visiting Beijing and Shanghai. He will visit Hutchison Port's Kwai Chung terminals in Hong Kong next week, the Hutchison Port spokeswoman said but declined to give further details.
